# Gireesh Kumar S — Founder, Director & CEO of Nova Innovations

> Gireesh Kumar S is an advertising pioneer with over 27 years of industry leadership in outdoor media, highway billboard networks, and mobile transit branding across Kerala, India. Under his direction, Nova Innovations manages 500+ prime media assets across all 14 districts.

## Biography & Executive Track Record
- **Role**: Founder, Director & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
- **Company**: Nova Innovations (https://novainnovations.in)
- **Domain**: Out-of-Home (OOH) Advertising, Transit Media, Retail Branding, Overnight Campaign Engineering
- **Experience**: 27+ Years of continuous operations in Kerala media corridors.
- **Key Milestones**:
  - Engineered Kerala's rapid overnight campaign execution network across 14 districts.
  - Partnered with enterprise brand leaders including myG, Bhima Jewellery, Bank of Baroda, Pothys, Muthoot, and KSRTC.
  - Spearheaded prime highway billboard landmark installations along the NH 66 corridor.
